title: APS B-side invite first-screen transcript fixture
scope: B receives a transferable APS invite prompt in a local AI tool before true two-machine UAT.
boundary: This fixture locks acceptable first-screen wording and failure samples. It is not real human UAT, not true two-machine evidence, and not Drive timing proof.

qcContract.scenarioBoundary: Static invite scenarios only; not a full APS handoff acceptance run.
qcContract.noviceBoundary: Use only as an evaluator fixture. Do not give acceptableFirstScreen, forbidden items, passCondition, or behindTheScenes text to a tested novice user or tested AI role as expected-route material.
qcContract.cognitiveLoadGuard: Keep this fixture separate from browser proof, operation smoke, observer judgement, and final UAT so one agent is not overloaded with conflicting roles.
stopGates: Stop if fixture answers or observer criteria reach the tested role.
Stop if a stage runs longer than 30 minutes without a checkpoint.
Stop if APS Live proof is claimed from about:blank, stale HTML, or static fixture text alone.
Stop if blocked tools, missing Drive proof, or missing browser proof are hidden in a pass result.
qcContract.lastSessionFailureGuard: S246, S247, and S248 were local or mixed same-machine defect-discovery evidence; this fixture must not be used to rename those sessions as complete uncoached novice UAT.

cases.matrixRow: B 貼邀請：未安裝 APS
cases.userInput:
---✂️---
請在目前本機工作目錄，按以下頁面完成 Agent Public Squares（APS）安裝、加入或升級：
https://adamchanadam.github.io/agent-public-squares/docs/guides/aps-ai-agent-install.html

邀請資訊如下：

APS 合作目錄名稱：brand_launch_room
邀請碼：APS-BRAN-0B05-CDDC
Google Drive 共用資料夾名稱：Agent_Public_Squares
邀請人：user_a
---✂️---
cases.localState: No .aps/config.json exists in the current local AI work directory.
cases.acceptableFirstScreen: 這是 user_a 邀請你加入 APS 合作目錄 brand_launch_room 的邀請。我會先讀安裝指引和檢查目前本機工作目錄；如果未安裝 APS，下一步只需要你提供兩項資料：你自己電腦上的 Google Drive 共用資料夾本機路徑，以及你想使用的用戶名稱。上面的網址是給本機 AI 代理讀取和執行，不是叫你手動輸入命令。
cases.behindTheScenes: Read the invite, read the AI-agent install guide, check whether .aps/config.json exists, then prepare one upfront install/join plan. Write only after user confirms the plan.
forbidden: 請你自己輸入 npx
請另開一個本機工作目錄
使用邀請人的 Google Drive 路徑
請 user_a 先替你取 APS 名稱
你有 A / B 兩條路
cases.failureSample: 你現在有 A / B 兩條路：A 是另開新本機工作目錄，B 是使用 user_a 的邀請碼。請先輸入 npx aps init。
cases.passCondition: A non-technical invitee knows to provide only their own Google Drive local path and chosen user name; no command typing or work-directory switch is requested.

cases.matrixRow: B 貼邀請：已有同一 APS 合作目錄
cases.userInput: B pastes the same transferable invite while the current local work directory already has .aps/config.json pointing to the same APS exchange and brand_launch_room.
cases.localState: .aps/config.json exists and matches the invite APS exchange and APS cooperation directory. The local user name is already set.
cases.acceptableFirstScreen: 你目前這個本機工作目錄已經接到同一個 APS 合作目錄 brand_launch_room，不需要重裝 APS，也不需要重建 Google Drive 資料夾。我會先做只讀狀態檢查；建議下一步是 Check APS，確認你是否已加入、協作者是否可見，以及共同目標與分工是否已存在。
cases.behindTheScenes: Read .aps/config.json, compare the invite cooperation directory and exchange folder, then run only read-only status checks unless the user explicitly asks to repair a real mismatch.
forbidden: 重新安裝 APS
覆寫 .aps/config.json
請重建 Google Drive 資料夾
請另開一個本機工作目錄
這是另一個新項目
cases.failureSample: 這個邀請可能是另一個新項目。安全做法是另開一個本機工作目錄，重新安裝 APS。
cases.passCondition: The first screen preserves the existing local configuration and directs the user to read-only Check APS / baseline confirmation.

cases.matrixRow: B 貼邀請：已有不同 APS 合作目錄
cases.userInput: B pastes A invite for brand_launch_room while .aps/config.json points to packaging_review_room in the same or another APS exchange.
cases.localState: .aps/config.json exists but the configured APS cooperation directory differs from the invite.
cases.acceptableFirstScreen: 我檢查到目前本機工作目錄已接到另一個 APS 合作目錄 packaging_review_room，而你剛貼上的邀請是 brand_launch_room。這不是叫你換本機工作目錄；要決定的是這個工作目錄接下來預設連到哪個 APS 合作目錄。就本次合作而言，我建議使用剛貼上的邀請 brand_launch_room；我會先列出會改哪些本機 APS 設定，經你確認後才寫入。
cases.behindTheScenes: Read current .aps/config.json and invite data, show both cooperation directories and exchange roots, recommend one target based on the newly pasted invite, and dry-run the config change before writing.
forbidden: 預設另開新工作目錄
把本機工作目錄當作 APS 合作目錄
兩個邀請碼可以一起用
直接覆寫設定
請自己理解 invite code
cases.failureSample: 你應該另開 C:\Users\you\APS_join_user_a，因為這是另一個項目。把 jay 的邀請碼用在目前工作目錄會混亂。
cases.passCondition: Conflict is explained only because a real mismatch exists; the user gets one recommended path and a no-write preview.

cases.matrixRow: 互邀：A 和 B 都發過邀請
cases.userInput: B has already generated an invite for A, then pastes A invite for brand_launch_room into the local AI tool.
cases.localState: The local conversation or fixture contains two invite codes for two possible APS cooperation directories.
cases.acceptableFirstScreen: 這是互邀情況。兩個邀請碼不需要互相使用，也不應建立兩條平行合作線。就本次合作，應選一個 APS 合作目錄作唯一交換空間；如果沒有其他已確認共同目標，我建議採用你剛貼上的 brand_launch_room 邀請加入，另一個邀請碼先不用。我會先核對兩份邀請的合作目錄和 Google Drive 共用資料夾名稱，再列出將採用哪一份。
cases.behindTheScenes: Compare invite code, sender, APS cooperation directory, and shared folder name for both invites. Pick a single cooperation directory; do not merge invite codes or initialize two rooms.
forbidden: 雙方都要用自己的驗證碼
兩個邀請碼要合併
建立兩個 APS 合作目錄
邀請碼就是身份
互相加入對方的項目才安全
cases.failureSample: 你要堅持使用自己產生的邀請碼，叫對方加入你的項目；同時也可以再用對方的邀請碼另開一個項目。
cases.passCondition: Only one cooperation directory remains active for the collaboration; the unused invite code is explicitly set aside.
